## History

After being sent from the States to reside with his grandmother in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), Stanhope was raised by her according to traditional principles regarding moral conduct and eating habits. [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later brought him to meet Miss Rosalind at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where the two quickly formed a bond during their visit. The following summer, Stanhope caught up with returning friends like [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), and he came to realize that he was growing out of his childhood fairyland fantasies.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), +4 more_

## Relationships

### [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--stanhope.md)

Stanhope is the father of [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md). After [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) reunited with [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) was brought to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) where he quickly bonded with her, later growing out of his childhood fairyland fantasies as he matured.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005)_

- Parent of  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005)</sub>
- Relative of — grandmother  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v3 ch.People P11](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0011)</sub>

### [Grandma Stanhope](../character/grandma-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-stanhope--stanhope.md)

[Grandma Stanhope](../character/grandma-stanhope.md) is the paternal grandmother of [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), serving as the relative responsible for raising her grandson.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012)_

- Relative of — paternal grandmother raising her grandson  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012)</sub>

### [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rosalind-penrose--stanhope.md)

[Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) is the wife of Stanhope. The pair were originally separated long ago by a prideful misunderstanding during their initial engagement, but after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) sent a letter to [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), he visited [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) where they embraced as lovers. They subsequently married in an outdoor ceremony in the cottage garden before being seen off by their friends at the train station.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), +14 more_

- Spouse of (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Change P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)</sub>
